This course has many strengths. In comparison to the previous years, this year in IAED202 we were given a very large and complicated building to design, which in my opinion, is a strength that has prepared us at a maximum level for the projects we will encounter in the upcoming years. A weak aspect of this course is that we were given a little too many homework assignments which sort of took away from the time I allocated for improving my project. However, I would also like to state that most of the assignments were also very helpful in encouraging us to think about different aspects of the project.  In my opinion, the homework assignments can be lesser in amount or lesser in requirements to not be so time-consuming. Overall, I believe that this course was very enjoyable and crucial within our education, especially with Burcin hocam's critiques and insight.

The negative side of the course is that there are 45 students and 3 teachers. In addition, some students ' criticisms lasted more than 1 hour, while others did not get critical at all. This is a great injustice. I got lost in this class and tried really hard to learn something. Also, no one can sit and focus for 5 hours without a break. We even get permission to take a 2-minute break. I don't understand why they force a college student to do this. In addition, having 6 credits in this course creates unnecessary stress on the student. We all know this lesson is important. By making this lesson 6 credits, you do not give us the chance to make mistakes, but in lessons you can always say "let's learn from mistakes".

course: The strongest aspect of the course was that it provided a smooth transition from basic design and abstract ideas to interior architecture and concrete notions. I personally find it a strong aspect that this course was solely based on hand-drawn drawings, because it really helped us grow in that area from perspectives to plans and sections, however, the requirements for pre-juries could have been a little m-more concise. Another strong aspect is that this course is being taught by Burçin hocam along with Serpil hocam.

Dersi her zaman takip etmeme, hiçbir şekilde devamsızlık yapmamama ve birçok şeye rağmen çok zorlayıcı bir dersti bu dönem. Requirementların sayısı ve her birini hand drawn teslim edecek olmamız nedeniyle belki de tasarımıma daha çok odaklanabilecekken yetiştirme kaygısından dolayı odaklanamadım.
